recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a male figure in urban-formal attire against a textured metallic background, featuring a stark contrast between ultra-thin hairline typography and heavy, blocky display lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the central figure and flanking hairline text
Contrast between the organic pinstripe pattern and the rigid geometric background
Hierarchy established by the oversized, bottom-weighted primary title
Color coordination between the red shirt stripes and the red typographic accents
coreInvariants: Combination of hairline and heavy-weight sans-serif fonts
Red as the primary accent color against a monochromatic base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, white-filled block lettering at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face/sunglasses, moves outward to the flanking thin text, and drops down to the heavy base title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced on the left and right shoulders against the textured wall.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson red (shirt stripes and typographic outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with low-saturation tones, punctuated by high-saturation red details.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to silver, black, white, and red

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-heavy, wide-set capitals with minimal counters
Secondary text uses extreme hairline weights with wide tracking
Horizontal rules used to separate text tiers
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'THE' prefix is rotated 45 degrees and integrated into the first letter of the main title

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the subject

graphicDevices: Patterned red banner behind main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric purity and weight range
Classic geometric choice for high-contrast urban layouts

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium portrait of a man in a black pinstripe suit, red striped shirt, black baseball cap, and sunglasses, centered against a textured silver metallic wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large white block-letter title at the bottom with a red patterned background. Add thin hairline text on the left and right sides of the subject's head, separated by thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the main title the heaviest visual element?
Are the flanking texts perfectly symmetrical in placement?
Does the red accent color match across shirt and text?
Is the background texture visible but not distracting?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Clashing font styles (e.g., mixing serif and sans)

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic alignment with the subject's center line
Ensure the pinstripe pattern does not create moiré effects
Verify the 'hairline' text is legible against the metallic background
Confirm the red banner behind the title is centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical urban portrait + Metallic texture + Hairline/Black font pairing + Red accent color
